title: Debt repayment planner
subtitle: Compare payoff dates and interest with a monthly payment you choose.
loadError: Debt balances could not be refreshed. Refresh this page to calculate a current plan.
unavailable: Debt balances are not available yet. Refresh this page to try again.
empty: Add a liability above, including its interest rate and monthly payment, to plan its repayment.
extraHint: Added to your existing monthly payments.
invalidExtra: Enter a valid amount of zero or more.
separateCurrencies: Each currency has its own plan and extra payment. Balances in different currencies are never added together.
incomplete: Complete these details in the liabilities above to calculate this currency's plan. Enter 0 for an interest-free debt.
baselineHint: Current payments stop when each debt closes. Both repayment strategies keep the total monthly payment, including your extra amount, and redirect freed payments to the next debt.

status.incomplete: Check the payment amount and debt details to calculate a plan.
status.non_amortizing: These payments cannot pay off all balances at the entered rates. Increase the monthly amount or review the debt details.
status.horizon: Some debt remains after 50 years. Increase the monthly amount or review the debt details; the schedule below is partial.
status.numeric_limit: These amounts or interest rates are too large to calculate reliably. Review the debt details.

assumptions: Estimate for tracked standalone liabilities, using the balances as entered. Payments start next month. Rates and regular payments stay fixed; annual interest is divided by 12 and rounded monthly to two decimals. Excludes fees, indexation, new borrowing and early repayment charges. Check your lender's terms before changing a payment.
